decision: pin provider specs by SHA-256: commit Linear's (MIT); fetch Okta, Google, Jira and Slack into a git-ignored cache checked against the hash
why: Ayoub chose pin by hash, cache locally; Okta, Google and Jira state no licence that allows redistribution; Slack's MIT spec has example tokens that push protection blocks, and bypassing the scanner is not this session's call

decision: hash Google's discovery document over canonical JSON (sorted keys)
why: two fetches hours apart had the same revision and content but different key order and byte hash

decision: contract test replays each connector on its fixture through a recording API and looks up every request path, query parameter and field read in the pinned spec
why: a connector can only be trusted to read real APIs if its fixture matches the provider's documented shape
evidence: test/contracts/contracts.test.ts: 5 providers pass; a Jira mutant with no fields= and a total read fails with 10 problems

decision: Jira issue search asks for labels, status, resolution, assignee and fixVersions with fields=
why: the enhanced search returns only ids unless fields are named, so a live read would have failed
evidence: tickets.ts jiraIssueSearch; contracts test checks every field read was requested

decision: Jira issue search completeness comes from isLast only; total is no longer read
why: the enhanced search response has no total
evidence: tickets.test.ts, hardening.test.ts updated; contracts paging test pins total as undefined

decision: Okta group profile.app and app profile.businessOwner are custom profile properties, allowlisted with their reason
why: Okta's spec defines neither; companies add them through profile extension
